scope: Native macOS Metal RVM optimization and Windows-compatible H.264 export

methods.inference: Five alternating warmed trials on predecoded clips repeated five times. First ten output frames excluded. Includes normalization, inference and mask conversion; excludes decoding, encoding and compilation.
methods.whole_export: Five alternating warmed trials against original binary. Includes process startup, decoding, inference, encoding and finalization.
methods.fast_h264: Five alternating warmed trials on clip A, nine on clip B, against preceding optimized pipeline with original compression. Same model, ratio and resolution.
methods.fps_hint: Nine alternating warmed full-export trials per clip; seven alternating isolated encoder trials. FPS hint varied independently of sample timestamps.
methods.quality: All 489 frames and exact source timestamps checked. Compression quality uses video-range luma against uncompressed masks. Enlarged edge composites inspected locally.

selected_encoder.expected_fps: finite positive source nominal frame rate when available

interpretation.fps_hint_retained_for: Correct automatic H.264 level selection. Clip A now declares level 4.2 for 1080p60, instead of level 4.0.
interpretation.quality: Visually unchanged in inspected composites. Small inference floating-point differences remain; H.264 is lossy relative to raw masks. Compression PSNR and mean edge error improve slightly on both test clips.
interpretation.size_limit: Both supplied clips stay within 5% of preceding output size. Constant quality does not enforce a universal byte-size cap.
interpretation.timing_limit: Short clips and warmed caches; results depend on hardware, OS encoder and content. Inference throughput is distinct from full-export throughput.
rejected_experiments: Larger queues, earlier conversion, startup overlap, zero-copy BGRA wrapping and readiness callbacks produced no useful stable full-export gain.
Parallel encoding improved an isolated long encoder test by 21%, but complete segmented exports lost the advantage to buffering, startup and joining costs. Prototype removed.
Average-bitrate fast encoding had worse faint-edge fidelity than quality 0.83.
Adding expected FPS to legacy default compression increased isolated clip A size by 32.46%; legacy mode intentionally omits the hint.

validation.native_codec_checks: MOV/MP4, fractional FPS hints, 1080p60 level selection, VFR/sub-millisecond PTS, odd/padded/general BGRA input, invalid storage and early teardown passed.
validation.clippy: Passed with pre-existing upper_case_acronyms and arc_with_non_send_sync exemptions.

publication: Anonymized aggregate metrics only. No input paths, original clip names, media, masks, model weights, profiles, raw frame hashes, host identifiers, binary artifacts or local logs are included.
